items.name: FTP data
items.use: Transfers the actual files. Port 21 is control; port 20 is data.

items.name: FTP control
items.use: Control port for FTP. Port 21 is commands; port 20 transfers files.

items.name: SSH
items.use: Designed to transmit data through a remote connection.

items.name: SFTP
items.use: Separate from FTP. Uses SSH to encrypt file transfers. Not FTP-server compatible.

items.name: SMTP
items.use: Sends outgoing mail from email clients to mail servers.

items.name: TACACS+
items.full_name: Terminal Access Controller Access-Control System Plus
full_name_answers: terminal access controller access control system plus
terminal access controller access-control system plus
items.use: Cisco proprietary protocol for authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA).

items.name: DNS
items.use: Associates IP addresses with domain names.

items.name: DHCP server
items.use: Assigns IP addresses and host config (mask, gateway, DNS). Server listens on 67.

items.name: DHCP client
items.use: Client side of DHCP. Clients use port 68; servers use 67.

items.name: HTTP
items.use: Websites and most internet traffic.

items.name: Kerberos
items.use: Network authentication over a non-secure network. Primarily UDP, can use TCP.

items.name: POP3
items.use: Email clients download mail from servers. One-way communication, unlike IMAP.

items.name: NTP
items.use: Low-latency protocol that synchronizes timekeeping across a network.

items.name: SMB session
items.use: Legacy SMB over NetBIOS session, TCP 139. Used when 445 does not complete the handshake.

items.name: IMAP
items.use: Email clients talk to mail servers. Two-way, unlike one-way POP.

items.name: SNMP query
items.use: Monitor and manage network devices. Queries/gets use 161; traps use 162.

items.name: SNMP trap
items.use: Device alerts/notifications (traps) sent to a manager on 162.

items.name: LDAP
items.use: Manage and communicate with directories (users, groups, objects).

items.name: HTTPS
items.use: HTTP over TLS. Most websites use HTTPS instead of HTTP.

items.name: SSTP
items.use: Microsoft VPN that replaced PPTP and L2TP/IPsec. Uses TLS over 443.

items.name: SMB
items.use: Direct SMB over TCP (no NetBIOS) on 445. Clients try 445 first, then fall back to session on 139.

items.name: ISAKMP
full_name_answers: internet security association and key management protocol
items.use: IPsec key management: Internet Security Association and Key Management Protocol.

items.name: SMTPS
items.use: Secure SMTP using TLS for encryption (mail submission).

items.name: LDAPS
items.use: LDAP over TLS for encrypted directory traffic.

items.name: FTPS data
items.use: FTP with TLS. Data channel; often 989. Can also run on 20.

items.name: FTPS control
items.use: FTP with TLS. Control channel; often 990. Can also run on 21.

items.name: IMAPS
items.use: IMAP over TLS for encrypted two-way email.

items.name: POP3S
items.use: POP over TLS for encrypted one-way email download.

items.name: RADIUS auth
items.use: AAA for network services. Authentication/authorization on 1812.

items.name: RADIUS accounting
items.use: RADIUS accounting (AAA). Accounting uses 1813.

items.name: RDP
items.use: Windows proprietary protocol for remote desktop connections.

items.name: Diameter
items.use: AAA protocol developed as an upgrade to RADIUS.

items.name: SRTP
items.use: Replaced RTP. Streams audio and video over UDP, with encryption.

items.name: L2TP
items.use: VPN tunnels over UDP. Needs IPsec for encryption. PPTP extension, data-link layer.

items.name: PPTP
items.use: Deprecated PPP-based VPN protocol. Replaced by SSTP / L2TP+IPsec.

items.name: TCP
items.use: IP suite transport with error checking so packets are not lost in transit.

items.name: UDP
items.use: IP suite transport that sends datagrams best-effort. No error checking.
